title: Lamb Curry: Rogan Josh
ingredients: Around 600-700 grams of leg of lamb - chopped into bite-sized chunks – cut most of fat off
The usual chunks of garlic, ginger
method: Fry onions in oil until soft – about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger and fry for another 3 minutes.
Add spices and fry for 2 minutes.
Add lamb and fry on high heat for about 5 minutes until meat well browned.
Add chopped tomato and salt then cook for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add a couple of big dollops of yoghurt and bring to fierce boil.
Put lid on and simmer for 90 minutes stirring occasionally.
